items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: George Howard decided that he didn't -- he wanted to go home... But he left on account of that and we replaced him.

ctx.x: The band stayed the same up until Russia. Going into Russia, George Howard decided that he didn't -- he wanted to go home. It wasn't George as much as it was his chorus girlfriend. She wanted to go and George thought, 'Well, I'll go home.' And he regretted it many a day, before he died. He regretted that. But he left on account of that and we replaced him.
But you went -- so you went to Sweden and how long did you stay there? Was it at Stockholm?
